title: Gold Nuggets Across the Big Questions

indicator_semantics.green: productive research or method progress; not a truth verdict
indicator_semantics.amber: promising lead with unresolved interpretation; not a probability
indicator_semantics.red: evidential blocker or no present movement; not proof of falsehood

question_movements.note: Cross-case timing patterns and prospective protocols create testable leads without identifying survival or reincarnation as the mechanism.
Dream and memory evidence strengthens ordinary cognitive accounts without resolving the origin of subjective awareness.
Do not pre-empt or duplicate the canonical title, status or evidence profile being developed separately.
Identity-bearing information must be distinguished from personal survival, living-agent effects and ordinary access.
Information, identity and conscious persistence are separate claims.
Belief-neutral care can respect transformative experiences without authenticating or ridiculing their interpretation.
The current evidence batch supplies no discriminating evidence for cosmic purpose or teleology.
Balance, resilience and symbiosis can inspire design without transferring mechanisms across domains.

adult wellbeing and perceived impact follow-up
source_records.limitation: small impact study; not historical verification
independent linguistic and source verification required
institutional records are not independent confirmation
guidance rather than an experimental verdict

governance: Presence in the archive is not scientific validation.
Unavailable or access-limited sources remain undetermined rather than false.
Signals describe inquiry progress, not probability, truth or metaphysical promotion.
Original URLs and retrieval context must be preserved.
